item.title: Odisha 2nd-largest contributor to nation’s investment intents
item.description: New Delhi/Bhubaneswar: India saw new investment announcements worth Rs 26.62 lakh crore in the first nine months of FY26, with Odisha bringing 13.1 per cent of such intents, taking the second spot after Andhra Pradesh (25.3 per cent), according to a new report Saturday. item.title: Four killed in stone quarry explosion in Odisha’s Dhenkanal
item.description: Dhenkanal: A powerful explosion rocked a stone quarry near Gopalpur village under Motanga police limits in Dhenkanal district Saturday evening, reportedly killing four workers.
